newsitem.title: UK: LME climbs off lows, markets finish mixed.
newsitem.headline: LME climbs off lows, markets finish mixed.

text.p: COPPER - Ends little changed after day traders cover. Support seen around $2,460 earlier, but still seen favouring downside.
ALUMINIUM - Finishes firmer, market caught short rallies.
NICKEL - Steadier at $7,200, bolstered by possible prolonged Inco strike. LEAD - Unchanged. ZINC - Powers up to firmer close.
TIN - Closes with pared losses at $5,600. ALLOY - Steadier.
